sentences: 中国有句老话："一日为师，终身为父"。
A Chinese saying goes, "A teacher for a day is a father for life."
在中国人的观念里，老师不仅传授知识，更教给学生做人的道理。
In Chinese culture, teachers not only pass on knowledge but also teach students how to conduct themselves.
在古代，学生初次见老师时要举行隆重的仪式，足见老师地位之高。
In ancient times, a grand ceremony was held when students first met their teachers, reflecting the high status of teachers.
为弘扬尊师的优良传统，中国从1985年开始将每年的9月10日定为教师节。
To promote the tradition of respecting teachers, China designated September 10 as Teachers' Day in 1985.
在这一天，学生以各种方式表达对老师的敬意。
On this day, students express their respect for teachers in various ways.
尊师是中华民族的传统美德，在当今社会得到了发扬光大。
Respecting teachers is a traditional Chinese virtue that continues to flourish in today's society.
餐桌礼仪 (dining etiquette) 是中华传统文化的重要组成部分，蕴含着热情有礼的待客之道。
Dining etiquette is an important part of traditional Chinese culture, embodying warm and courteous hospitality.
为了招待客人，主人会根据客人的口味和喜好准备丰富精致的菜肴。
To entertain guests, hosts prepare a wide variety of exquisite dishes according to their guests' tastes and preferences.
就餐座位的安排非常讲究，主人坐在正对大门的位置，在主人身边就座的是最重要的客人。
Great care is taken over seating arrangements, with the host facing the main entrance and the most important guest seated beside the host.
进餐时，主人会不时地为客人添酒加菜。
During the meal, hosts refill their guests' wine glasses and offer them more food from time to time.
这种独特的餐桌礼仪已延续了数千年，对促进和谐的人际交往起到了重要的作用。
This distinctive dining etiquette has been observed for thousands of years and has played an important role in promoting harmonious social relations.
在中国传统文化中，亲朋好友之间互赠礼物是人际交往的一种重要礼节 (etiquette) 。
In traditional Chinese culture, exchanging gifts among relatives and friends is an important form of social etiquette.
赠送礼物不仅是物质的馈赠，更是情感的表达，是维系人际关系的重要纽带。
Giving gifts is not merely a material gesture but also an expression of affection and an important bond that sustains personal relationships.
一份精心挑选、符合接受者喜好的礼物，往往能加深彼此的感情。
A carefully chosen gift that suits the recipient's preferences can often strengthen the emotional bond between people.
中国人遵循"礼尚往来" (mutually exchanging courtesies)的传统，接受礼物时会表达谢意，并适时回赠礼物，以增进彼此的融洽关系。
Following the tradition of reciprocity, Chinese people express their gratitude when receiving gifts and return the courtesy at an appropriate time to strengthen their relationships.
科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展。
Technological advances have enabled China's healthcare sector to develop rapidly.
近年来，远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者。
In recent years, telemedicine has made quality medical resources accessible to more patients.
医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询，指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案。
Medical specialists can offer video consultations to patients in remote areas and guide local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans.
人工智能辅助诊 断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，提高诊断准确率。
Artificial intelligence-assisted diagnostic systems help doctors identify patients' early symptoms and improve diagnostic accuracy.
电子健康档案的普及让医生能够快速了解患 者病史，避免重复检查。
The widespread use of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly access patients' medical histories and avoid unnecessary repeat examinations.
线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊。
Online medical consultation platforms have made it much more convenient for patients to seek medical advice.
科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求。
The close integration of technology and healthcare has better met people's health needs.
电子商务的蓬勃发展正在深刻改变中国农村的面貌。
The rapid growth of e-commerce is profoundly transforming rural China.
随着互联网和物流网络快速向农村延伸， 越来越多的农村居民通过电子商务平台将农产品直接销售给城市消费者。
As internet and logistics networks rapidly expand into rural areas, more and more rural residents are selling agricultural products directly to urban consumers through e-commerce platforms.
近年来，直播带货 ( live- streaming commerce) 使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动，已成为促进农村发展的一种新方式。
In recent years, live-streaming commerce, which allows urban consumers to interact with sellers in real time, has emerged as a new way to promote rural development.
电子商务打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒，拓宽了农产品销售渠道，帮助农村居民增收致富。
E-commerce has broken down information barriers between urban and rural areas, broadened sales channels for agricultural products, and helped rural residents increase their incomes and prosper.
数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合，正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力。
The close integration of the digital economy and rural revitalization is bringing unprecedented vitality to rural development in China.
近年来，中国无人机(drone) 产业蓬勃发展，出口量跃升为全球第一。
In recent years, China's drone industry has flourished, with its export volume rising to first place worldwide.
中国的无人机以出色的稳 定性、高清 (high-definition)拍摄能力和便捷的操作，受到全球消费者的喜爱，在民用领域得到广泛应用。
Chinese drones are popular with consumers worldwide for their excellent stability, high-definition imaging capabilities and ease of operation, and are widely used in civilian applications.
无人机已被国家纳入战略性新兴产业，逐步成为能满足多种场景需求的智能助手。
The drone industry has been designated a strategic emerging industry in China, and drones are gradually becoming intelligent assistants capable of meeting a wide range of needs.
在农村，无人机可精准识别农作物病虫害，高效喷洒农药。
In rural areas, drones can accurately detect crop diseases and pests and spray pesticides efficiently.
在城市，无人机可快速运送生鲜食品。
In cities, drones can deliver fresh food quickly.
在不久的将来， 无人机能够在更多领域实现其独特价值，为经济社会发展注入新动能。
In the near future, drones will demonstrate their unique value in more fields, giving fresh impetus to economic and social development.
近年来，中国政府高度重视民营经济(private economy)的发展，出台了一系列政策支持民营企业。
In recent years, the Chinese government has placed great emphasis on developing the private sector and introduced a range of policies to support private businesses.
民营企业的研发投入不断增加，在新一代信息技术、人工智能等领域发展迅速。
Private companies are investing more in research and development and making rapid progress in fields such as next-generation information technology and artificial intelligence.
民营企业核心竞争力的增强为中国经济的高质量发展提供了有力支撑。
The growing core competitiveness of private enterprises has strongly supported the high-quality development of China's economy.
与传统旅游不同，城市漫步不追求在短时间内游览尽可能多的景点。
Unlike conventional tourism, city walking does not aim to cover as many attractions as possible within a short time.
漫步者品尝地道小吃，欣赏特色建筑，了解当地生活方式。
People on city walks sample local snacks, appreciate distinctive architecture and discover how local residents live.
这种旅游方式能让城市漫步者更深入了解城市的历史与文化。
This form of travel gives walkers deeper insight into a city's history and culture.
通过加强森林资源保护、加大污染治理力度等一系列措施，许多地区的生态环境得到了显著改善。
Measures such as tighter protection of forest resources and stronger pollution control have significantly improved the environment in many regions.
绿水青山 (lucid waters and lush mountains) 促进了当地的旅游、健康等产业的发展，创造了可观的经济效益。
Clear waters and green mountains have stimulated local industries, including tourism and wellness, generating substantial economic benefits.
绿色经济的推进不仅能为中国可持续发展做出贡献，也为全球环境保护提供了宝贵经验。
Developing a green economy can support China's sustainable development while offering valuable lessons for environmental protection worldwide.
被誉为"杂交水稻(hybrid rice)之父"的袁隆平和他的科研团队克服重重困难,研发出了一种超级杂交水稻。
Yuan Longping, widely known as the father of hybrid rice, worked with his research team to overcome numerous obstacles and develop a variety of super hybrid rice.
通过这项技术的应用,水稻抗旱抗病能力更强,能适应不同的气候和土壤条件,产量可提高20-30%。
With this technology, rice becomes more resistant to drought and disease and better adapted to different climates and soils, while yields can rise by 20-30%.
目前,这项技术已经在许多国家得到广泛应用,为全球粮食安全做出了重大贡献。
Now widely used in many countries, this technology has made a major contribution to global food security.
例如,哈尔滨利用丰富的冰雪资源打造了极具地方特色的"冰雪大世界",让游客在欣赏冰雪之美的同时也能体验当地独特的民俗文化。

Harbin, for example, has drawn on its abundant ice and snow resources to create the locally distinctive Ice and Snow World, where visitors can enjoy frozen scenery and experience the area's unique folk traditions.
如今,曾令人畏惧的冰天雪地正吸引着四面八方的游客,成为深受欢迎的旅游胜地。
Once daunting, the region's icy, snow-covered landscapes now draw tourists from far and wide and have become much-loved holiday destinations.
冰雪旅游业正为当地的经济发展做出越来越大的贡献。
Tourism based on ice and snow is making an ever greater contribution to the local economy.
社区居民步行15分钟就能享受到日常所需的公共服务。
Residents can reach the public services they need in everyday life within a 15-minute walk from home.
生活圈内建有便利店、公园、健身场地、图书馆、学校、社区食堂、诊所等。
These neighborhoods provide convenience stores, parks, exercise facilities, libraries, schools, community dining halls and clinics, among other amenities.
生活圈的建立能够为居民提供更加便利、舒适、友好、愉悦的生活环境,更好地满足城市居民多元化的日常生活服务需求,提升居民的生活品质和幸福感。

Such living circles offer a more convenient, comfortable, welcoming and pleasant environment, better address residents' varied everyday needs, and improve their quality of life and sense of well-being.
近年来,中国在减少空气、水和土壤污染上取得了显著成效。
China has made considerable progress in recent years in reducing pollution of the air, water and soil.
为了不断改善人们的生活环境,中国采取了一系列有效措施,包括大力发展清洁能源,改善公共交通,推广共享单车,实施垃圾分类。
To continually improve living conditions, China has introduced effective measures such as expanding clean energy, upgrading public transport, encouraging bike sharing and implementing waste sorting.
中国还积极参与国际合作,为全球环境保护做出了重要贡献。
China also takes an active part in international cooperation and has made a significant contribution to protecting the global environment.
中国政府通过加大资金投入和政策引导，鼓励新能源汽车企业进行技术创新，不断提高产品在市场上的竞争力。
With increased funding and policy guidance, the Chinese government encourages new energy vehicle manufacturers to pursue technological innovation and continually make their products more competitive.
中国新能源汽车产业的发展不仅有力推动了国内经济发展，也为全球新能源利用和环境保护做出了积极贡献。
Growth in China's new energy vehicle industry has strongly supported the domestic economy and contributed to the use of new energy and environmental protection worldwide.
敦煌莫高窟 (Mogao Grottoes) 数字展示中心于2014年开放启用, 是莫高窟保护利用工程的重要组成部分。
The digital exhibition center at the Mogao Grottoes in Dunhuang opened in 2014 as an important part of the project to conserve the site and manage its use.
展示中心采用数字技术和多媒体展示手段, 使游客进入洞窟参观之前就能了解莫高窟的历史文化, 鉴赏莫高窟的艺术经典。
Using digital technology and multimedia presentations, the center enables visitors to explore the grottoes' history and culture and appreciate their artistic masterpieces before entering the caves.
这将减少开放洞窟的数量, 缩短游客在洞窟内的逗留时间, 减轻参观对莫高窟造成的影响, 以使这一世界文化遗产得到妥善保护、长久利用。

This will reduce the number of caves open to the public, shorten the time visitors spend inside and lessen the impact of tourism, ensuring this World Heritage site's lasting protection and sustainable use.
四合院(siheyuan)是中国一种传统的住宅建筑，其特点是房屋建造在一个院子的四周，将院子合围在中间。
A siheyuan is a traditional Chinese home in which buildings stand on all four sides of a central courtyard, enclosing it.
四合院通常冬暖夏凉，环境舒适，尤其适合大家庭居住。
Warm in winter and cool in summer, siheyuan offer comfortable surroundings that make them particularly suitable for large families.
如今，随着现代城市的发展，传统的四合院已逐渐减少，但因其独特的建筑风格，四合院对中国文化的传承和中国历史的研究具有重要意义。

As modern cities expand, traditional siheyuan are becoming less common, yet their distinctive architecture makes them important to the preservation of Chinese culture and the study of Chinese history.
农历 (the lunar calendar) 起源于数千年前的中国，根据太阳和月亮的运行规律制定。
Originating in China thousands of years ago, the lunar calendar was devised according to the movements of both the sun and the moon.
古人依据农历记录日期、安排农活，以便最有效地利用自然资源和气候条件，提高农作物的产量和质量。
People in ancient times used the lunar calendar to record dates and organize farm work, making optimal use of natural resources and climatic conditions to improve crop yields and quality.
农历是中国传统文化的重要组成部分，当今依然广为使用。
An integral part of traditional Chinese culture, the lunar calendar remains widely used today.
人们通常将一个大大的福字写在红纸上, 寓意期盼家庭幸福、社会安定、国家昌盛。
People often write a large Chinese character fu on red paper to express their hopes for family happiness, social stability and national prosperity.
为了欢庆春节, 家家户户都会将福字贴在门上或墙上, 表达对幸福生活的向往、对美好未来的期待。
During the Spring Festival, households display the character fu on doors and walls to show their desire for a happy life and their hopes for a bright future.
人们有时还将福字倒过来贴，表示幸福已到、好运已到。
Sometimes the character fu is displayed upside down to signify that happiness and good fortune have arrived.
尊老是中华民族的传统美德，深深植根于中国人的思想和行为中，是人们普遍遵守的行为规范和社会准则。
Respect for the elderly is a traditional Chinese virtue deeply embedded in thought and behavior, serving as a widely accepted code of conduct and social norm.
为老年人提供便利服务已成为社会共识，例如社区专门开设长者食堂，公共场所配置优先座位。
There is broad social agreement on providing convenient services for the elderly, as illustrated by community dining halls for seniors and priority seats in public places.
尊老是社会和谐与发展的重要基石，有助于培育良好的社会氛围，推动整个社会文明进步。
Respect for older people is fundamental to social harmony and development, helping create a supportive social climate and advance society's cultural and ethical progress.
中华民族崇尚自强自立的精神，这一精神深植于中国文化之中，是民族生存与发展的重要支撑。
The Chinese nation cherishes self-improvement and self-reliance, a spirit deeply embedded in its culture and crucial to its survival and development.
改革开放以来，中国在自强自立的征程上，持续加大科研投入，在信息技术、人工智能、航天工程等领域不断取得新突破。

Since the launch of reform and opening up, China has steadily increased investment in scientific research in pursuit of self-reliance, achieving successive breakthroughs in information technology, artificial intelligence and aerospace engineering.
自强自主精神成为推动国家现代化进程的强大动力，激励着中国人民为实现民族复兴 (rejuvenation) 的中国梦不断奋进。
Self-improvement and self-reliance have become powerful drivers of China's modernization, inspiring its people to strive continuously toward the Chinese Dream of national rejuvenation.
在中国古代，生产力低下，先人们深知劳动成果来之不易，因而秉持节俭的理念。
In ancient China, low productivity taught people how hard it was to obtain the fruits of labor, leading them to value frugality.
到了物质极大丰富的今天，中国人民依然坚持节俭的生活方式，体现了理性消费的生活理念和对劳动的尊重。
Even in today's age of material abundance, Chinese people continue to live frugally, demonstrating sensible consumption and respect for labor.
近年来，中国政府持续加强节约型社会的建设，倡导"光盘行动"，减少食物浪费，提倡简约低碳的生活方式，推进资源循环利用，反对过度消费。

In recent years, China's government has strengthened efforts to build a resource-conserving society by promoting the Clean Plate Campaign, cutting food waste, encouraging simple, low-carbon lifestyles, expanding recycling and discouraging excessive consumption.
天宫空间站已实施180多个科学研究与应用项目,涉及空间生命科学、太空医学、空间材料科学等领域。
The Tiangong Space Station has conducted over 180 scientific research and application projects covering space life sciences, space medicine and space materials science.
天宫空间站的研究成果在我国得到了广泛应用,产生了显著的经济效益。
Findings from research aboard Tiangong have been widely applied in China, yielding significant economic benefits.
这不仅标志中国在航天技术上取得了巨大进步,也表明中国为全球的太空研究和应用做出了重大贡献。
This demonstrates China's remarkable advances in space technology and its substantial contribution to space research and applications worldwide.
大湾区是中国开放程度最高、经济活力最强的区域之一,在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位。
As one of China's most open and economically dynamic regions, the Greater Bay Area holds a strategically important position in the country's economic development.
大湾区不仅将建成充满活力的世界级城市群和具有全球影响力的国际科技创新中心,还将打造成适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈。

The Greater Bay Area will become a vibrant, world-class city cluster and a globally influential center for technological innovation, as well as a high-quality living area for work, shopping and tourism.
随着改革开放的不断深入,大湾区的建设将进一步推动区域经济发展。
As reform and opening up deepen, the development of the Greater Bay Area will provide further momentum for regional economic growth.
自古以来,中国的水资源北缺南丰,分布极不均衡。
China's water resources have always been distributed very unevenly, with shortages in the north and abundance in the south.
为了有效解决北方严重缺水问题,中国政府实施了南水北调工程(the South-to-North Water Diversion Project)。
To address the severe shortage of water in northern China effectively, the government launched the South-to-North Water Diversion Project.
北斗(Beidou)卫星导航系统的成功研制是中国自改革开放以来取得的一项重大科技成就。
The successful development of the Beidou satellite navigation system represents a major scientific and technological achievement for China since reform and opening up began.
研发人员经过不懈努力,攻克了一系列技术难题,北斗系统最终实现了全球覆盖和高精度定位,使中国成为世界上少数几个独立拥有全球卫星导航系统的国家之一。

By overcoming a series of technical challenges through sustained effort, researchers enabled Beidou to provide worldwide coverage and highly accurate positioning, making China one of the few countries with an independently developed global satellite navigation system.
北斗系统现在已经在国际上得到广泛认可,开始为越来越多的国家和地区提供优质服务。
Now widely recognized internationally, Beidou has begun delivering high-quality services to a growing number of countries and regions.
数字技术和人工智能的使用大大减少了用工成本和碳排放。
Digital technology and artificial intelligence have substantially lowered labor costs and carbon emissions.
洋山港将不断发展,为把上海建成一个全球航运中心做出更大贡献。
Yangshan Port will continue to grow and contribute more to Shanghai's development into a global shipping hub.
近年来,中国航天进入创新发展"快车道",太空基础设施建设稳步推进,中国空间站于2022年全面建成。
In recent years, China's space program has moved onto a fast track of innovation, with steady progress in space infrastructure and the full completion of China's space station in 2022.
中国航天事业的迅速发展在中华民族的历史上写下了辉煌一页,也为人类文明进步做出了巨大贡献。
The rapid growth of China's space sector has added a glorious chapter to the nation's history and made a significant contribution to the advancement of human civilization.
未来,中国探索太空的脚步将迈得更稳、更远。
In the years ahead, China will move forward more steadily and explore still farther into space.
婚礼场地经过精心装饰，以象征喜庆 (jubilance) 的红色为主色调，摆放着许多祝愿新人幸福的物件。
Carefully decorated in red, a color symbolizing celebration, the wedding venue is filled with objects conveying wishes for the newlyweds' happiness.
在婚礼上，新人要拜天地 (bow to Heaven and Earth)、拜父母和相互对拜，然后设宴招待宾客，并向宾客敬酒致谢。
At the wedding, the couple bow to Heaven and Earth, to their parents and to each other before hosting a banquet and toasting their guests to express thanks.
竹子实用性强，用于生产和生活的许多方面，如筷子、桌椅的制作和桥梁、房屋的建造。
Bamboo has many practical uses in production and daily life, from making chopsticks, tables and chairs to constructing bridges and houses.
中国人爱竹，自古以来就有无数文人以竹为主题，创作了绚丽多彩的文学和绘画作品。
Chinese people's love of bamboo has inspired countless scholars since ancient times to produce a rich variety of literary works and paintings on the subject.
竹子具有强大的生命力和适应能力，无论环境多么恶劣，都能够顽强生存，因而寓意坚韧不拔的精神。
With its remarkable vitality and adaptability, bamboo can survive even the harshest conditions and thus represents the spirit of perseverance.
扇子自古以来就深受中国人喜爱，但现在已不只是消暑纳凉的工具，而更多地作为艺术品供人欣赏。
Although fans have been popular in China since ancient times, they are now used less as cooling tools and more as works of art to be admired.
扇子常作为礼物赠予他人，表达美好的祝福和真挚的情感。
Giving a fan as a present is a common way to convey good wishes and heartfelt feelings.
